gold.disambiguation_note: Latency-dominant, sub-ms-class control -> URLLC despite low stated rate; beta_in set to band low-mid (20 Mbps).

intent: Give me a fast slice for lots of video to lots of people, don't care too much about delay.

gold.disambiguation_note: Throughput-dominant, delay-tolerant, many users -> eMBB full chain; delay mid-band (45 ms).

intent: Thousands of tiny sensors trickling data all day; it can be slow but must scale massively.

gold.disambiguation_note: Massive low-rate device count, delay-tolerant -> mMTC; full gateway-aggregator-analytics chain.

intent: Cars talking to the roadside to avoid crashes, needs to be quick but it's outdoor vehicular.

gold.disambiguation_note: Vehicular safety, moderate rate + low delay -> V2X (V2XController is the signature VNF); URLLC also defensible on the latency-criticality reading.

intent: Headset experience with heavy rendering, both high bandwidth AND low latency.

gold.disambiguation_note: Joint high-throughput + low-delay + rendering -> XR (MediaProc); eMBB defensible if the translator lacks an XR concept and reads it as high-bw video.

intent: Critical alarm signaling - small payloads but it absolutely cannot be late.

gold.disambiguation_note: Reliability/latency-critical, tiny payload -> URLLC; firewall + vUPF at edge.

intent: Just normal internet for an office, nothing special.
